summary: Dedicated WhatsApp Secret Code vault with normal text fields, privacy isolation and adaptive pattern recognition.

changes.title: WhatsApp-only secret code
changes.detail: Exact WhatsApp app and focused UID only; ordinary text fields supported. Optional Search metadata restriction; never auto-submit.

changes.title: Persistent private field protection
changes.detail: Guard fields before insertion and on reopen; no suggestions, learning, swipe predictions, autocorrection, clipboard suggestions or voice in guarded fields. Unknown field IDs fail closed. Authenticated reset only after code removal.

changes.title: Adaptive gesture enrollment
changes.detail: Three encrypted enrolled shapes with majority matching, start/success/rejection feedback, and editor/cursor cancellation. Re-enroll your WhatsApp secret code; older generic mappings are not silently reused.
